name: HERALD-glyph-in-another-colour
old: herald: TITLE_RGBA.herald,           // HERALD: the trumpet in the title's azure
new: herald: TITLE_RGBA.apostle,           // HERALD: the trumpet in the title's azure
note: The trumpet in the Apostle's violet: the two halves of one grant drift apart.

name: HERALD-a-mark-another-glyph-has
old: herald: '<',        // HERALD: the trumpet's bell, flaring the way the glyph's does
new: herald: '|',        // HERALD: the trumpet's bell, flaring the way the glyph's does
note: The classic face would draw Penitent's blade beside a Herald's name.

name: HERALD-the-colour-the-shields
note: The moderator's shield blue: a Herald read as staff.

name: HERALD-the-bell-flaring-back
note: The bell turned back over the mouthpiece.

name: HERALD-the-banner-above-the-tube
note: A pennant flown above the tube, not a herald's banner hanging from it.

name: HERALD-the-notch-filled
note: A plain flag: the swallowtail is what reads as a banner at a name's size.

name: HERALD-the-glyph-without-the-title
note: A Herald drawn with Penitent's sword. AEGIS (re-aimed by content): the line gained Sureme's aegis. PRIMARCH (re-aimed by content): the line gained GA00250's primarch. CRYSTAL-FIST (re-aimed by content): the line gained Flylighter's crystalfist.

name: HERALD-the-tier-unmapped
note: Mac's Herald patrons hold nothing by their pledge.

name: HERALD-the-list-crossed-with-penitents
note: Diggleborf a Herald by the Penitent's line.

name: HERALD-the-vocabulary-without-it
note: A title the token cannot carry: every Herald's mint throws, and the relay refuses the hello. THE SEATS ARC'S MERGE (PIN MOVED): re-aimed by content - herald stands after the Gatebreaker now, the seats' after it.

name: HERALD-the-trumpet-filled
old: penitent: true, herald: true, tower: false,
new: penitent: true, herald: false, tower: false,
note: The trumpet filled: a solid blot at a name's size. THE SEATS ARC'S MERGE (PIN MOVED): re-aimed by content - herald stands after the Gatebreaker now, the seats' after it.

name: HERALD-the-mark-dropped
old: herald: '<',        // HERALD: the trumpet's bell, flaring the way the glyph's does
new: herald: '',        // HERALD: the trumpet's bell, flaring the way the glyph's does
note: The classic face draws nothing beside a Herald's name.
